settings.title: Customer Stories
settings.intro: Jewelry becomes part of the lives of the people who wear it.

settings.heading: Our Etsy Community
settings.text:
Our story has grown through two distinct Etsy shops. Lansattic is home to pearls and fine jewelry; StudioLibraArt focuses on jade, jadeite and natural gemstones.

The selected reviews below are attributed to the shop where each customer purchased their piece. Together, they are part of the history behind Lansattic.com.

settings.quote: A very dainty and gorgeous necklace! I love how vintage it feels.
Excellent seller and beautiful ring! The seller was really helpful and kind.
First time buyer. The clip-on earrings are pretty and it's comfortable for daily wear.
